name: ratnapura-earthquake-demo
title: Earthquake felt in Ratnapura (made-up example)
story: A magnitude 6.8 earthquake is reported near Ratnapura and confirmed by a second agency a minute later. ATLAS treats steep roads as blocked (rockfall and slides) and moves people to open ground and shelters.
assumptions: Synthetic event: no damaging earthquake has been recorded at Ratnapura. The format matches what atlas/datasets/usgs.py produces from a live USGS feed.
Steep roads (15% grade and over) within 1.2 km are put in doubt at M4.5 and treated as blocked from M6.75 (1.5x the threshold), a demo rule for rockfall and triggered slides.

payload.text: Synthetic: M 6.8, 18 km from Ratnapura, depth 10 km.
Synthetic: second agency, M 6.7, same event.
